The '''Barison system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barison]].
